placements.why: This envelope's content — adopting a database technology for the analytics pipeline, a columnar-query performance claim, and a migration timeline — is technical-infrastructure content. No strata category exists yet in this repo, and among the org's named tiers (Opportunity/Strategy/Product/Architecture/Organization/Proof/Templates/Calibration) none but 'Architecture' plausibly holds a database/pipeline technology decision, so this mints that exact top-level category rather than inventing a novel one.
placements.title: technical infrastructure and system-design choices become their own organizational category
placements.frame: Does this content concern the org's technical infrastructure, system design, or platform/tooling choices, distinct from business strategy, product scope, or process?

placements.title: infrastructure tool adoption ratified and justified by quantified performance gains
placements.frame: What performance rationale, ratifying commitment, and timeline bind each infrastructure or database adoption decision, and how does confidence in the claimed gain hold up as more such decisions accrue?
placements.why: Src-1's present-tense 'we are adopting' ratifies the database choice, src-2 supplies the quantified columnar-performance justification, src-3 commits the org to a migration start date, and src-4's bulleted digest re-performs all three as a settled record. Together they instantiate a theme — infrastructure/database adoption decisions ratified and justified by performance metrics and bound by a timeline — that future envelopes about other tool or platform choices would keep feeding; the specific 15x figure and Q3 date are evidence for this theme, not leaves in their own right (narrative grain test). No existing leaves or strata were available to reuse, since the supplied graph structure and strata are both empty.
